summary.en-US: Automatically generate labeled email addresses for better organisation and spam protection.

description.en-US:
Email Address Plus automatically adds website-specific labels to your email address when filling forms, making it easy to track where emails come from and organise your inbox.

**Key Features:**
• **Smart Email Labeling**: Automatically adds "+website" labels to your email (e.g., user+amazon@example.com)
• **Multiple Fill Methods**: Floating icon, right-click context menu, or keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+Y)
• **Visual Feedback**: Elegant animations confirm when fields are filled
• **Dark/Light Theme Support**: Works seamlessly across all browser themes
• **Privacy Focused**: All processing happens locally - no data sent to external servers
• **Easy Setup**: Simple one-time configuration in extension settings

**How it works:**
1. Configure your email address in the extension settings
2. Visit any website with email input fields
3. Use the floating 📧 icon, right-click menu, or keyboard shortcut to auto-fill
4. Your email gets automatically labeled with the website name

Perfect for organising newsletters, shopping accounts, and identifying spam sources. Compatible with all major email providers that support plus-addressing (Gmail, Outlook, etc.).
